The '''''Ao Var''''' was a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]]<ref name="TLCSB" /> [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] with a crew capacity of at least one. It was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Pash]], but technically was the property of [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|cartel]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].

==History==
The ''Ao Var'', a [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]]<ref name="Pash" /> with a crew capacity of at least one, was manufactured by [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]]<ref name="TLCSB" /> and [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Pash]]. However, it was technically the property of [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|cartel]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Pash was given the ship to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] Teemo's cargo in and out of [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]]&mdash;a settlement on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]&mdash;after his arrest and release by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] soon after the Imperial [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]]-sympathizing planet during the time of a [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|rebellion]] against the Empire. While flying the ''Ao Var'', Pash was shot at by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Customs official/Legends|customs officials]] and had to risk landing the craft in remote, dangerous locations. Rusty and old at this point, eight [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of transporting cargo under harsh conditions damaged it beyond repair, moving Pash to sell it as parts scrap when he got it back to Mos Shuuta. Pash decided to escape off-planet rather than face Teemo's displeasure.<ref name="Pash" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ghtroc720-SotG07.png|200px|thumb|A typical Ghtroc 720 light freighter]]
The ''Ao Var'' was briefly mentioned in the prologue to [[Fantasy Flight Games]]{{'}} [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|''Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game]] adventure, "[[Escape from Mos Shuuta]]," in the character folio biography for Pash that was included with the game released on [[December 14]], [[2012]].<ref name="Pash" />
